Who we are:

We are a team of Proactive, Respectful, Communicative, Candid, Diverse, Equitable and Curious leaders seeking new team members who share our values. We are world-class experience designers, technologists, strategic thinkers and creators assembled to develop global design projects for adventurous, industry-changing Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations.

Who you are:
You are a spatial thinker with an artist’s sensibility. You understand that architecture is not just about buildings—it’s about the way people feel, move, and find meaning in the spaces around them. You work fluidly across scales: from a human-scale sculpture and installation to a building façade or master plan. You are conceptually driven, aesthetically sharp, and more interested in the emotional texture of space than the technical mechanics of construction. You have a portfolio that reflects genuine creative range, a strong point of view, and a hunger to push what the built environment can be.

Role Overview

As a HUSH Architectural Designer, you bring a design sensibility rooted in art, culture, and human experience. You are the creative force that shapes how our spaces look, feel, and resonate—translating brand narratives and human stories into spatial and experiential language. You work across project types and scales, contributing to concept development, mood and aesthetic direction, and the visual logic that guides how a project comes to life. You collaborate closely with designers, technologists, and strategists to ensure every environment we create leaves a lasting impression.

Focus: 80% making and execution; 20% learning and concepting

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to spatial concept development—from big ideas to the refined aesthetic details that define a project’s character.

  • Develop mood boards, visual narratives, and inspiration frameworks that guide the creative direction of spaces.

  • Shape the experiential arc of a space—how people enter, move through, pause, and feel in an environment. Journeys, mapping, narratives.

  • Collaborate with designers, technologists and fabricators to translate conceptual vision into realized work.

  • Contribute to pitch development with strong visual storytelling and spatial thinking.

  • Articulate design ideas clearly and compellingly in both visual and verbal form.

  • Seek and embrace feedback. Iterate with intention. Evolve the idea without losing the soul of it.

Evaluation

Bi-annual meetings to review progress across core responsibilities, professional, and personal goals.

Requirements

  • 2–4+ years of design experience in architecture, experience design, spatial design, or a related creative field.

  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture, fine arts, interior design, or equivalent work experience—formal architectural training is appreciated but not required.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates conceptual range, aesthetic sophistication, and comfort working across scales.

  • Strong skills in visual communication: sketching, mood-making, spatial storytelling.

  • Proficiency in tools such as Rhino, Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, or similar. 3D rendering, AI rendering.

  • Genuine curiosity for art, culture, technology, and sensorial experience.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills—you are as comfortable in a concept conversation as you are presenting work to a client.

Job Description: Architectural Designer

Position Overview

We are seeking a talented Architectural Designer with expertise in House design principles and advanced skills in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing innovative architectural concepts, preparing detailed drawings and 3D models, and ensuring that designs meet both aesthetic and technical standards. This role requires creativity, precision, and the ability to collaborate with architects, engineers, and clients to deliver high-quality projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop architectural designs and concepts aligned with House design principles.
  • Prepare detailed architectural drawings, plans, and elevations using AutoCAD.
  • Create 3D models and renderings in Revit and SketchUp to visualize design intent.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, and contractors to refine and implement design solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and sustainability standards.
  • Conduct site visits to gather data and verify design accuracy.
  • Prepare presentation materials for client meetings, including renderings and design boards.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, materials, and innovative design practices.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in architectural design.
  • Portfolio showcasing projects that demonstrate proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Honne design principles and their application in architectural projects.
  • Proficiency in Revit for BIM modeling and construction documentation.
  • Advanced skills in AutoCAD for drafting and technical drawings.
  • Expertise in SketchUp for conceptual design and visualization.
  • Familiarity with sustainable design practices and modern building materials.

BBS Architects, Landscape Architects & Engineers, P.C. is a NY-based, ENR New York Top 100 design firm that continually strives for excellence in providing integrated architectural, landscape architectural, Civil and M/E/P engineering solutions to help our clients successfully plan, design, and build their projects.

With 75% of our valued staff being employed at BBS for over 10 years, and many for over 20 years, our vision is long term, and it includes the most talented individuals in the industry. At BBS you will contribute to a wide range of projects that help our clients understand the challenges placed before them today while connecting them to the future. We support a workplace culture that encourages innovation, creativity and camaraderie.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for an ambitious and dedicated Architectural Designer/Draftsperson. The selected candidate should have several years of experience in K-12, higher educational, and other municipal projects. The candidate will have experience in working in teams with other professionals including Senior Architects/Project Managers, and project-level architects and engineers.   • Generate designs and renderings, both interior and exterior, to the client’s approval.
  • Bring those designs into Construction Drawings alongside the project team under supervision of a Senior Architect/Project Manager.
  • Follow production schedules and meet multiple simultaneous deadlines.
  • Contribute to growing our practice through new business development initiatives including but not limited to assistance with new client outreach, follow-up, and marketing.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong design and graphic skills, with ability to work in Sketch-Up, Revit, and other modeling/presentation software packages.
  • Bachelor of Science in Architecture (4-year degree), Bachelor of Architecture (5-year degree) preferred.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Microsoft Word and Excel, and Adobe.
  • Excellent verbal, written and visual communication skills.

BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Comprehensive, competitive compensation package.
  • Group health insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance plans
  • Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Company-paid group life insurance.
  • Supplemental life, spousal and dependent life and AFLAC plans available.
  • 401k plan.
  • Company-paid holidays, vacation and sick/personal time.
  • Professional development program, professional licensing/certifications reimbursement.

If interested, please send your resume to Joseph Rettig, AIA, LEED AP,
